notes:
Wk19 clean, all logged. Levers advance: archer → full reps, dips ROM deepens, pike lowers, pull-ups → volume. Curls drop from program (pull-ups cover elbow flexion). BSS + reverse lunges missed wk19 (no weights) → hold, not advance. Load capped ~11kg → tempo, range and rest are the levers.

PAIN RULE (all days): ≤3/10 during, baseline within 24h, no added AM stiffness. Fail → drop back one step.

HARD STOP: clicking/catching/locking, rest/night pain, week-over-week worsening, numbness/tingling/weakness, a pop.

STILL OUT:
- One-arm push-ups, HSPU — after archer full reps are clean.
- Full-ROM dips — 2 clean weeks at ~120° first.

Rest: 3 min main lifts, 60–90s accessories.

exercises.name: Archer push-ups
exercises.cue: New main push. Form breaks → finish that set as eccentrics.
exercises.raw: Archer push-ups, FULL reps: 4×3/side — new main push. Form breaks → finish that set as eccentrics.

exercises.name: Archer eccentrics
exercises.raw: Archer eccentrics: 2×4/side, 5s lower — backoff.

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.raw: Decline push-ups: 2×8, 3s down / 1s pause / 1s up — keep wk19 foot height.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.cue: Deepened, 2 clean partial weeks banked. Reps hold.
exercises.raw: Dips, ROM ~120°: 3×6, slow — deepened, 2 clean partial weeks banked. Reps hold.

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.cue: Right-shoulder lingering returns → back to 3 books, no retry until a painless week.
exercises.raw: Pike push-ups: 3×5, 2 books — lower one notch.

exercises.name: Hollow body
exercises.cue: Rest is the lever (75–80s last week).
exercises.raw: Hollow body, weighted: 3×35s, 1kg/hand, rest 60s — rest is the lever (75–80s last week).

exercises.name: Biceps curls
exercises.raw: biceps curls, effective sets, 12kg (14kg if hitting 15+ reps), 3 sets, 35 sec rest

days.notes: Norwegian 4×4. Priority run. Report AVG pace per interval, not peak. Target avg 4:20–4:25/km, all four within 5s. Pace moves up only on a matched 4-rep set. Rain cuts it → drop a rep, keep interval length.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.raw: 10–12 min warm-up, easy → moderate.

exercises.name: Norwegian 4×4
exercises.cue: RPE 8, no full sentences, not a sprint. Recovery is an easy JOG @ ~70%.
exercises.raw: 4 rounds: 4 min @ 90–95% HRmax (RPE 8, no full sentences, not a sprint) / 3 min easy JOG @ ~70%.

exercises.name: Cooldown
exercises.raw: 5 min cooldown. Work at intensity: 16 min.

days.notes: No weights available → bodyweight versions, 2s pauses, +50% reps. Don't skip the day.

exercises.name: Box pistols
exercises.cue: L first. Last rep fails → 5s negative.
exercises.raw: Box pistols: L first. L 4×5 (first 4 unassisted).

exercises.name: Box pistols
exercises.raw: R 4×5, all unassisted — last rep fails → 5s negative.

exercises.name: Deficit Bulgarian split squats
exercises.raw: Deficit Bulgarian split squats (front foot ~10cm elevated): 4×6/side, 11kg, 3s down + 2s pause — hold.

exercises.name: Kickstand RDL
exercises.raw: Kickstand RDL: 3×8/side, 10kg, 3s down — +2kg. Back talks → strip load.

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.raw: Reverse lunges, backpack 11kg: 3×8/side, 3s down + 2s pause at bottom — hold.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.raw: Single-leg calf raise, deficit: 3×12/side, 11kg, 3s down + 3s stretch at bottom — tempo, not reps.

exercises.name: Biceps curls
exercises.raw: biceps curls, effective sets, 12kg (14kg if hitting 15+ reps), 3 sets, 35 sec rest

days.notes: Curls dropped — 5×2 pull-ups holds. Own hypertrophy sets fine after pull work, 2×/wk cap.

exercises.name: Scapular pulls
exercises.raw: Scapular pulls: 2×8, 2s hold at top — warm-up only.

exercises.name: Full pull-ups
exercises.cue: THE lift, done fresh. End the set the moment form drops to chin-over. Target ≥12 clean total (wk19: 10).
exercises.raw: Full pull-ups: 5×2–3, chest-to-bar, 3 min rest — THE lift, done fresh.

exercises.name: Negatives
exercises.raw: Negatives, unassisted, 5s lower: 2×3 — backoff.

exercises.name: Inverted rows
exercises.cue: Legs STRAIGHT, heels on floor. Fix one bar height and stop changing it. Can't hit 8 straight → 4×6 straight.
exercises.raw: Inverted rows, pronated: 4×8, 2s pause at chest — legs STRAIGHT, heels on floor.

exercises.cue: Slow, no swing. Straight legs before more reps.
exercises.raw: Hanging leg raises: 3×6, legs near-straight, slow, no swing — straight legs before more reps.
